description_en: Queries attack and defense events on the dashboard
description_zh: 查询大屏攻击防御事件
name: DescribeScreenAttackAnalysisData

parameters.help_en:
The details of attack analysis. Valid values:

TOTAL: total number of attacks
TREND: attack trends
PIE_CHART: attack type distribution
SOURCE_TOP: top 5 attack sources
CLIENT_TOP: top 5 attacked assets
DETAILS: list of attack details

If Type is set to DETAILS, paging parameters are required
parameters.help_zh:
攻击分析的详情。取值：

TOTAL：攻击次数
TREND：攻击趋势
PIE_CHART：攻击类型分布
SOURCE_TOP：攻击来源TOP 5
CLIENT_TOP：被攻击资产TOP 5
DETAILS：攻击详情列表

当Type取值为DETAILS时，分页参数为必填项
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp when the attack started. Unit: seconds.
The start time must be within the last 40 days
parameters.help_zh:
攻击开始的时间戳，单位为秒。
开始时间只能为近40天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the attack ended. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 攻击结束的时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions for attack events.
Description of the crack_type field:
3: MySQL brute-force attacks
4: FTP brute-force attacks
5: SSH brute-force attacks
6: RDP brute-force attacks
9: SQL Server brute-force attacks
101: Java Struts2 attack blocking
102: Redis attack blocking
103: AntSword WebShell communication
104: China Chopper WebShell communication
133: XISE WebShell communication
sqli: SQL injection
codei: code execution
xss: XSS attacks
lfi: local file inclusion
rfi: remote file inclusion
webshell: script trojan
upload: upload vulnerability
path: directory traversal
bypass: unauthorized access
csrf: CSRF
crlf: CRLF
other: other
parameters.help_zh:
攻击事件的筛选条件。
crack_type字段类型说明
3：MySQL暴力破解
4：FTP暴力破解
5：SSH暴力破解
6：RDP暴力破解
9：SQL Server暴力破解
101：Java Struts2攻击拦截
102：Redis攻击拦截
103：中国蚁剑WebShell通信
104：中国菜刀WebShell通信
133：XISE WebShell通信
sqli：SQL注入
codei：代码执行
xss：XSS攻击
lfi：本地文件包含
rfi：远程文件包含
webshell：脚本木马
upload：上传漏洞
path：路径遍历
bypass：越权访问
csrf：CSRF
crlf：CRLF

parameters.name: data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform Base64 encoding on client_url in the query results. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果是否需要对client_url进行Base64编码。取值：

true：需要
false：不需要
parameters.name: base64

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return. Pages start from 1.

If Type is set to DETAILS, this parameter is required.
If Type is not set to DETAILS, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为1。

当Type取值为DETAILS时，该参数为必填。
当Type取值不为DETAILS时，该参数不能填
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of attack events to return on each page.
If Type is set to DETAILS, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
设置分页查询时，每页显示的攻击事件信息的数量。
当Type取值为DETAILS时，该参数为必填
parameters.name: page_size

Data.description_en:
The list of attack events. This list includes the following fields:

client_url: The URL of the attack request.
internetIp: The IP address of the asset instance.
instanceName: The name of the asset instance.
table_src: The data source.
uuid: The UUID of the asset instance.
crack_method: The attack request method.
crack_hour: The attack time.
crack_src_ip: The IP address of the attacker.
instanceId: The instance ID.
dst_port: The destination port.
client_ip: The target IP address.
location: The region of the attacker.
aliuid: The Alibaba Cloud account ID.
crack_cnt: The number of attacks.
crack_type: The attack type. Valid values:
